entities.title: MCP roots are not used
entities.summary: The server never asks the client for roots/list; its roots are the --root arguments, or the working directory the client starts it in.
entities.impact: An MCP client's own idea of the workspace roots is ignored; zazzled always names the git work tree that holds its working directory, so this matters only to a serve session started by hand.
entities.workaround: Pass --root name=path to serve in the client's server configuration.

entities.title: Tools only, and none listed
entities.summary: The server has no resources, prompts or other MCP capabilities and announces only tools in initialize, yet tools/list is empty: its tools are internal calls zazzled makes by name.
entities.impact: An MCP client that starts zazzle-csharp-indexer serve sees no tools; agents reach the indexer only through zazzle.
